text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize the Optimize Toolkit scope for Q4. Customers keep pushing for three things: smarter batching heuristics, prescriptive quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Proposal for MVP:
- static batching heuristics + SDK examples
- KV/prefix caching guidance + suggestions
- quant profiles (int8/fp16) + recommended tradeoffs
- daily eval-triggered regression alerts (no realtime anomalies yet)

jeremy: +1 on focus. strong prefer we ship advisory recs (manual apply) instead of full autopilot for alpha. Also need to define p99 latency SLOs for mobile path.

sophia: FYI customer EduSoft called out that quant recs must not drop top-k accuracy > 1%. We need an eval harness that checks quality regressions per-profile.

lia: ops-bot: Capacity note — Dedicated pool is fairly constrained in Nov. If we plan pilot traffic, we should reserve autoscale buffer.

maya: Draft launch criteria to discuss:
1) docs + SDK examples and one quickstart
2) eval suite that detects regressions (quality + perf)
3) telemetry + cost accounting per profile
4) canary rollout (10% traffic) + rollback playbook
Does that look reasonable?

jeremy: Add explicit cost guidance: e.g. estimate cost per 1M tokens for common combos (no-quant, int8, batch=1/8/32). Also require model/quant/batch tags in telemetry.

sophia: Sample eval config we can start from:
```
# eval config
model: "redwood-open-1"
quant: "int8"
prompts: "batch_100_short"
metrics: ["semantic-sim", "chrF"]
thresholds:
  - metric: "semantic-sim"
    min: 0.92
```
We should run daily and fail the alert if any profile drops below threshold.

maya: Good. One pending scope decision: include adaptive batch sizing in MVP or push to next milestone? Adaptive needs runtime hooks in the serving runtime.

jeremy: Recommend postpone adaptive batching. Ship static heuristics + advisory engine that recommends a profile per route. Adaptive in alpha2.

lia: ops-bot: We can support daily eval jobs in staging. Realtime anomaly detection (5m windows) will need additional metric exporters and ~2 weeks of infra work.

maya: Okay decision: MVP = static batching heuristics + quant recommendations + daily eval-triggered alerts + docs + cost guidance + telemetry tags. Postpone adaptive batching and realtime anomaly detection to alpha2. @sophia @jeremy please ack.

sophia: ack :thumbsup:

jeremy: ack :thumbsup: I'll draft the acceptance criteria and tag owners this afternoon.

maya: I’ll set up a 30m scope huddle tomorrow 10:00 to lock owners and acceptance criteria. Agenda: acceptance criteria, telemetry schema, pilot customers. See pinned doc: https://company.internal/notes/optimize-toolkit-q4 (work-in-progress).

deploy-bot: Note — infra freeze scheduled 2025-11-20 -> 2025-11-25. Plan releases accordingly.

maya: Thanks — we'll avoid any infra migrations during that window.

(END)
